title.zh: CPU 的三级缓存是怎么工作的
title.en: How a CPU's Three Levels of Cache Work

desc.zh: 内存要等几十纳秒，CPU 一纳秒能做好几件事。几十 KB 到几十 MB 的缓存怎样让它大部分时候不用等？为什么分三级、每级为什么是现在这个大小？十个在真实地址序列上跑的缓存模型：地址怎么拆、相联度与三种缺失、LRU 与 RRIP、写回与写缓冲、包含与排他、L1 的容量上限、预取、MESI 与伪共享、追指针的延迟台阶。
desc.en: Memory takes tens of nanoseconds and a CPU does several things every nanosecond. How do caches of tens of kilobytes to tens of megabytes keep it from waiting most of the time? Why three levels, and why is each the size it is? Ten cache models run on real address traces: splitting an address, associativity and the three kinds of miss, LRU and RRIP, write-back and write buffers, inclusive and exclusive levels, the limit on L1 size, prefetching, MESI and false sharing, and the latency staircase of a pointer chase.

title.zh: 为什么要缓存，为什么不止一级
title.en: Why caches, and why more than one level

desc.zh: 存储越大越慢；几级缓存叠起来，让大部分访问在最近的一级办完。用 Zen 5 的真实延迟和重用距离算平均每次访问的周期。
desc.en: Bigger storage is slower; stacked levels let most accesses finish in the nearest one. Average cycles per access from Zen 5's documented latencies and reuse distance.

zh: 为什么 CPU 要有三级缓存
为什么缓存不能做得又大又快
en: why caches cannot be big and fast

desc.zh: 64 字节一行；地址切成标记、组号、行内偏移；直接映射的玩具缓存上两个数组互相挤掉。
desc.en: 64-byte lines; an address splits into tag, index and offset; two arrays evict each other in a direct-mapped toy cache.

zh: 标记 组号 偏移

title.en: Associativity and the three kinds of miss

desc.zh: 直接映射、组相联、全相联；用 Hill 的办法把缺失分成强制、容量、冲突，在同一个程序上扫容量和路数。
desc.en: Direct-mapped, set-associative and fully associative; Hill's method splits misses into compulsory, capacity and conflict, swept over size and ways on one program.

zh: 强制缺失 容量缺失 冲突缺失

title.zh: 满了换谁：LRU、伪 LRU 与 RRIP

desc.zh: 组满了换谁；比缓存稍大的循环让 LRU 一次不中；树形伪 LRU、随机、SRRIP、BRRIP 和 Belady 最优。
desc.en: Which line to evict; a loop slightly bigger than the cache defeats LRU; tree pseudo-LRU, random, SRRIP, BRRIP and Belady's optimum.

title.en: Write-back, write-through and the write buffer

desc.zh: 两种写法、写分配、脏位和写缓冲；四种策略各读写多少字节，写缓冲多深核心才不用等。
desc.en: Two ways to write, write-allocate, the dirty bit and the write buffer; bytes moved under four policies and how deep the buffer must be.

title.zh: 三级各管什么：包含、排他与共享 L3
title.en: What each level does: inclusive, exclusive and the shared L3

desc.zh: L1 分指令和数据、L2 私有、L3 共享切片；包含、非包含、排他三种关系下两级能装多少；Zen 5、Lion Cove、Neoverse V3、Apple M6 的真实配置。
desc.en: Split L1, private L2, sliced shared L3; how much two levels hold when inclusive, non-inclusive or exclusive; the real configurations of Zen 5, Lion Cove, Neoverse V3 and Apple M6.

zh: 私有 L2 共享 L3

title.zh: 为什么 L1 这么小

desc.zh: L1 用虚拟地址选组、物理地址比标记；组号要落在页内偏移里，容量就卡在页大小 × 路数。
desc.en: L1 picks a set with virtual bits and compares physical tags; the index must sit inside the page offset, so size stops at page size × ways.

zh: 为什么 L1 缓存这么小
en: L1 size limit page size times ways

desc.zh: 硬件预取器怎么猜下一行；按指令记步长的预取表；覆盖率和准确率，链表为什么预取不了。
desc.en: How hardware prefetchers guess the next line; the per-instruction stride table; coverage and accuracy, and why linked lists defeat it.

zh: 预取覆盖率 准确率

title.en: A first look at MESI, and false sharing

desc.zh: 一行在两个核心里各有一份时的 MESI 状态；两个不相干的计数器挤在同一行，行在核心之间来回搬。
desc.en: The MESI states of one line held by two cores; two unrelated counters in one line make the line bounce between cores.

zh: 两个核心写同一缓存行
en: two cores writing one cache line

title.zh: 追指针：看得见的缓存台阶
title.en: Pointer chasing: the cache staircase you can measure

desc.zh: 随机链表追指针，延迟随工作集一级级上跳；4 KiB 页让 L2 提前缺失，大页让各组均匀；查看本机缓存的命令。
desc.en: Chasing a random chain, latency steps up level by level; 4 KiB pages make L2 miss early and huge pages even out the sets; commands to read your own caches.

title.zh: 缓存的前沿（2026 年 11 月）

desc.zh: 叠在芯片下面的 3D V-Cache、服务器和 AI 芯片的几百 MB 大缓存、SRAM 几乎不再缩小，按证据强弱分类并注明日期。
desc.en: 3D V-Cache stacked under the die, server and AI chips with hundreds of MB of cache, SRAM that has nearly stopped shrinking; sorted by strength of evidence, with dates.

title.zh: 看一颗芯片的缓存时问三件事
title.en: Three questions about a chip's caches

desc.zh: 每级多大几路几个周期、哪几级共享与包含关系、程序的访问有没有规律。
desc.en: How big, how many ways and how many cycles at each level; which levels are shared and how they include each other; whether the program's accesses have a pattern.

zh: 怎么看 CPU 缓存参数
en: how to read CPU cache specs
